integrity: Analytic universal inequality and local/global comparison proved; symbolic checker is supporting exact-algebra evidence, not independent validation. Broader historical priority remains uncertain.
scientific_limitations: Directed three-stage cyclic phase-type generator, fixed return probability, positive holding means; not arbitrary cyclic generators or RK tableaux. The polynomial crossing identifies benchmark profiles only, not the global symmetry-breaking threshold. Positive finite witness exists.
title: Cyclic three-phase moment barrier with a locally stable but globally suboptimal equal-rate design
